item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday that Beijing has “influence” over Moscow it should use to stop the war in Ukraine, and that a proposed summit meeting of the US, Chinese and Russian leaders must not lead to the division of his war-torn country. item.title: Trump to cut some Canada tariffs to help Maine lawmaker’s re-election bid
item.description: The Trump administration is expanding tariff exemptions to more Canadian products, a move that may help boost Republican US Senator Susan Collins’ re-election campaign in Maine. item.title: Macron condemns ‘racist terrorist attack’ after deadly shooting near Paris
item.description: A gunman firing from a car killed one person and wounded five – including a 12-year-old girl shot eight times – in the Paris suburbs on Friday, in what the French president called a “racist terrorist attack”. The man was “firing at random, wanting to cause a bloodbath” as he drove through the working-class town of Trappes southwest of Paris and neighbouring La Verriere, Trappes mayor Ali Rabeh said. item.title: Gunmen kill 7 at Jordan church, king vows retaliation
item.description: Gunmen killed at least seven people and wounded dozens at a church in southern Jordan on Friday, authorities said, with the king vowing retaliation for the rare attack on Christians in the majority Sunni Muslim kingdom. Assailants stormed the compound of a Greek Orthodox church in the village of Hammoud in Karak governorate and opened fire, authorities said. The gunmen got out of a vehicle and started shooting during a funeral procession, the public security directorate said in a statement,...

item.title: Melania Trump brokers ceasefire in Russian-occupied Ukraine city, White House says
item.description: Ukraine’s top negotiator involved in a humanitarian mission led by US first lady Melania Trump said that a local ceasefire with Russia will start on Tuesday – two days before the mission begins – and last several days. Ukrainian, Russian and US negotiators reached a deal on Friday to provide humanitarian aid in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, in the war-divided region of Kherson in southern Ukraine.
